title: diagram-design: a Claude Code skill that turns your agent into an editorial graphic designer
description:
diagram-design is a Claude Code skill built by someone tired of fighting Figma for 30 minutes every time she needed an architecture sketch. Your agent becomes a high-end editorial graphic designer, generating stunning self-contained HTML and SVG files. Zero JavaScript, zero external images, zero build steps. 13 built-in structural types including sequence diagrams, state machines, Venn diagrams, and swimlanes.

https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design

#github #opensource
